**What you are trying to do**

Not the feature — the thing you are trying to get done. It is often possible
to help without building what was asked for.

**What you do today instead**

**Which platforms matter for this** (Android / iOS / macOS / Windows)

---

Some things are deliberately out of scope for v1: HOTP, Steam Guard and other
non-standard formats, push approval, SMS, browser extensions, Apple Watch and
Wear OS, and site icons. Importing from Authy is impossible — Authy has no
export. Saying why you want one of those is still useful; it just will not be
a quick yes.
